candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the order service fails: traces show POST order returning 502 Bad Gateway, and order's downstream payment call returns 503 Service Unavailable, propagating failure up to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, saturation, or crash) not established; logs excluded and no payment-side metrics available.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 caused by order 502, which stems from payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/redis succeed. Metrics confirm elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. Root cause is downstream payment failure, but payment-side evidence is absent, so the specific cause is bounded only to the order/payment path.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
Order service logs/metrics to confirm 502 origin and error handling
Gateway logs (excluded) for upstream error detail
